description: This file contains the implementation of the AuthSchemeResolver class, which handles selecting and validating authentication schemes for AWS services based on provided identities and configuration.

classes.name: AuthSchemeResolver
classes.description: Handles the logic for resolving and selecting AWS authentication schemes based on configuration and available credentials.

methods.name: selectAuthScheme
methods.description: Selects the first compatible authentication scheme from a list, returning its normalized signature version.

methods.name: isCompatibleAuthScheme
methods.description: Checks if a given auth scheme is compatible based on available credentials and extensions.

methods.name: getIncompatibilityMessage
methods.description: Provides a message explaining why an auth scheme is incompatible.

methods.name: hasAwsCredentialIdentity
methods.description: Determines if AWS credentials are available.

methods.name: hasBearerTokenIdentity
methods.description: Determines if a Bearer token identity is available.
